description: AUDIT Tier 1 (softlock), ported to the codex flow (WP-C7): a pending Moment Shackle choice must never hang an AI player. Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) Moment Shackle is a card in the start-of-phase window (phase_start), decided synchronously by AIDecisionMaker.decide_window_stratagem (CustodesAbilities.ai_score). Fixture cus11e_c7_fight: entering the Fight phase opens the window for P1 (human) with Moment Shackle + Neutronium Cascade Mine; P1 is then handed to the AI. Within the watchdog cycles the AI uses both (once-per-battle markers set, game log line) and no phase_start window is left open. Setup privileges: auto wound allocation; the Orks (P2) have 0 CP.

steps.comment: setup privilege: auto wound allocation; player(s) 2 CP 0 (no paid stratagem competes with the abilities under test) (see description)
